definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating regular intervals between occurrences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To take medicine every other day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{三|さん}⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{植|う}えて→植える：01210_ueru⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Trees are planted every three meters.

notes:
～おき indicates regular intervals. The number specifies how much time/space passes between each occurrence.

USAGE:
⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき means "every other day" (with one day gap between). This can be confusing - the number indicates the interval, not the frequency.

EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき: every other day (Mon, Wed, Fri...)
- ⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧おき: every third day (with two days between)
- ⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧おき: every two hours
- ⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧おき: every six minutes
- {三|さん}⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧おき: every three meters (spacing)

CONTRAST WITH ～ごとに:
- ～おき: interval between occurrences
- ～ごとに: each occurrence
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき = every other day
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧ごとに = every day

WATCH OUT:
Learners often confuse ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき (every other day) with ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ (every day).
